emailTemplates.subject: Thank You for Connecting with PIGL at NAICE SPE 2026 😊
emailTemplates.bodyHtml:
POLARIS INTEGRATED & GEOSOLUTIONS

Technical Engagement Desk • NAICE SPE 2026

Dear {{first_name}},

Thank you for visiting the Polaris Integrated & GeoSolutions Limited (PIGL) exhibition booth at NAICE SPE 2026 in Lagos, Nigeria.

We appreciated the opportunity to connect with you and discuss your organization's engineering and operational requirements. Our technical leadership team has logged your submission (Reference: {{submission_id}}) and assigned it to the appropriate division specialists.

PIGL Operating Divisions

  • Geosolutions & Engineering Services: 20-Ton CPT, Geotechnical Pontoon Drilling, 3D Laser Scanning.
  • Metocean & Marine Solutions: Multibeam Bathymetry, Oceanographic Buoys, Shallow Geophysical.
  • Integrated Construction Services: Swamp Flowline Laying, River Crossing, Structural Fabrication.
  • Industrial Solutions: Asset Integrity NDT, Cathodic Protection, Skid Maintenance, Produced Water Treatment.

Should you require immediate technical documentation or an engineering capability presentation, please feel free to reply directly to this email or reach us at info@polarisigl.com.

Warm regards,

Corporate Engagement & Business Development Team
Polaris Integrated & GeoSolutions Limited

© 2026 Polaris Integrated & GeoSolutions Limited. All rights reserved.

Plot 12, Commercial Area, Port Harcourt & Victoria Island, Lagos, Nigeria.
